verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized dashboard as a centralized hub, a Compliance Calendar with annual-report deadline reminders, and real-time compliance-status notifications, so the core pieces exist for a single business. Nothing shows one view across many entities and state registrations with standing and deadlines side by side. Missing for 10: multi-entity/multi-state portfolio view, standing displayed in the dashboard itself (status is only documented as notifications), a dashboard-level view of upcoming deadlines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines

citations.quote: Log in anytime to your personalized dashboard, a centralized hub for important updates and documents.
Email reminders about annual report deadlines through the Compliance Calendar
Real-time notifications about your compliance status, upon receipt of data from your state filing office
Proactive notifications on upcoming expiration dates and changes to your license report
